journey.name: DD-05 Today and tomorrow are worded, not counted
journey.description:
The two nearest cases in RelativeDate, and the two the seed data cannot reach: the four seed rows carry "in 3 days", "yesterday" and nothing at all, so "Due today" and "Due tomorrow" are strings the suite has never seen rendered. Both are reachable only through the picker.
They are worth a device journey rather than trusting the unit test that pins the arithmetic, because the wording is a separate resource lookup from the number - Today and Tomorrow are stringResource, InDays is a plural - and a wrong branch here reads as "Due in 0 days" or "Due in 1 day", which is the kind of thing only a person notices.
The date the picker returns is midnight in the picker's own reckoning; relativeDateOf converts through the viewer's zone, so this journey needs a device whose clock and zone are correct. It does not need either changed.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Verify that "No due date" is on screen
Select today's date in the picker and tap "OK"
Verify that "Due today" is on screen
Select tomorrow's date in the picker and tap "OK"
Verify that "Due tomorrow" is on screen
Verify that "Due today" is no longer on screen
Verify that the app returns to the "Tasks" screen
Verify that the "Book dentist" row shows "Due tomorrow"
